name: Bogripwedge
description: Hold the bo level across the chest at its midpoint, palms a shoulder-width apart, so the shaft covers throat and ribs.

name: Blockstrike
description: Slide the rear hand along the shaft as the front foot steps in, driving the near tip at the opponent's chest.

name: Open Balancenode
description: Raise one end high over the shoulder and bring it down on a straight vertical line to the crown or collarbone.

name: Bostipcowl
description: Swing the shaft across the body to brush an incoming blow aside toward the outer line, then return to guard.

name: Bogrippace
description: Keep the staff level while the feet shuffle forward in short steps that never cross and never lift high.

name: Skipping Taperend
description: Turn on the rear heel and back away while the tip stays pointed at the opponent to hold the distance.

name: Planted Leftgrip
description: Stand with feet apart and the bo planted upright beside the lead foot, one hand guarding the head.

name: Narrow Bogrip
description: Snap the staff forward from the lead hand alone to tap shoulder or brow before drawing it back.

name: Bostiplid
description: Pull the shaft across the body on a slant and meet the blow on its middle, knees bent to take the weight.

name: Stepping Staffcentre
description: Slide the rear foot beside the lead foot while the shaft points forward, keeping reach as the body withdraws.

name: Quick Tipcap
description: Drop the rear end low and rap the opponent's shin or knee with a short downward flick.

name: Bostip Stay
description: Turn both wrists in small circles so the near end draws a ring that carries jabs wide of the body.

name: Angled Roundstaff
description: After any strike, draw the staff back to the centre line and square the hips for the next exchange.

name: Angled Whitewood
description: Carry the staff upright at the side with one hand, then tilt it across the front to shield the body.

name: Bogripstrike
description: Thrust the end straight at the opponent's belt line with both arms, hips turning to add reach.

name: Folded Whitewood
description: Lift the far end sharply upward from below to knock a low strike off its line.

name: Tipjab Dodge
description: Step wide to one side with the staff held across the hips so the opponent's line of attack is left empty.

name: Gnawing Pivot
description: Strike the opponent's lead shoulder with the near end, then return the tip to the same spot in one rhythm.

name: Holding Roundstaff
description: Extend the staff forward at arm's length with both hands near one end, keeping the opponent beyond arm distance.

name: Sudden Block
description: Slide both hands to the rear end and lunge, driving the tip through a gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Pivotdash
description: Swing one end in a flat arc at ankle height to rap or knock away the opponent's front foot.

name: Narrow Sweepstep
description: Let the sweep carry past the target, then whip the other end back across the same line at the knee.

name: Tight Taperend
description: Slide the grip from centre to end in one motion, lengthening the guard before the opponent can close.

name: Pivothit
description: Jab to the face and snatch the staff straight back so a counter-grab closes on empty air.

name: Blockamble
description: Lean away from a reaching strike with one foot back, then step in under the staff to restore reach.

name: Resting Rightgrip
description: Turn the staff in a flat circle above the head to carry falling blows off to either side.

name: Folded Bostip
description: Set the feet so the tip just touches the opponent's lead guard, marking the exact edge of striking range.

name: Tipjabdrop
description: Flick the staff's tip at the opponent's leading wrist to force the hand back from its guard.

name: Skipping Block
description: Advance one pace for each probe while the shaft keeps level, so reach never falls short of the target.

name: Tipcapstay
description: Strike the incoming weapon with the staff's far end well ahead of the body, so the attack never arrives.

name: Sudden Sweepstep
description: Slip the tip around the opponent's guarding arm and drive it into the ribs from the side.

name: Tipcaphusk
description: Catch a closing opponent's chest with the rear end of the shaft, stopping the rush at its tip's length.

name: Bostipwedge
description: Stand on a drawn line with the staff slanted before the body, ready to meet a partner's first move.

name: Downward Bogrip
description: Match a partner's rhythm, then jab to the exact spot that partner's guard has just left open.

name: Bogriphit
description: Raise the far end in an arc over the partner's guard and drop it on the opposite shoulder.

name: Balancenode Pause
description: Lay the staff against an opposing shaft and press steadily to hold it away from the body.

name: Rightgrip Trot
description: Walk a small circle around the partner with the tip always facing in, never giving up the line.

name: Bogripcowl
description: Drive the shaft down onto an opposing weapon from above and pin its point toward the floor.

name: Angled Leftgrip
description: Bring the staff upright to the side and step back to the line, ending a round and resetting guard.

name: Solid Staffcentre
description: Let first qi flow into the palms so the grip tightens without strain and the staff rests steady across the body.

name: Wide Tipjab
description: Exhale as the staff drives forward, letting a thread of qi gather in the tip for a sharper point.

name: Planted Balancenode
description: Meet a strike with the shaft and draw it back along the qi in the arms, letting the blow slide past.

name: Shifting Bogrip
description: Push off the rear foot with qi gathered in the calves, closing the gap in one pace behind the staff.

name: Wide Roll
description: Pour qi into the far end at the top of a downward chop so the shaft lands heavier than its wood.

name: Bogriplid
description: Hold the staff slanted and breathe slowly, letting qi settle in the forearms before any spin begins.

name: Tipcapwedge
description: Spin the staff once around the wrist on one exhale, sweeping aside a strike that comes at hip height.

name: Bogrippause
description: Turn the staff in a flat spin above the head and shoulders, qi following each pass to cover the upper body.

name: Quick Pivot
description: Carry the spin into a half-turn and let the rear end whip out to strike what stands beside the body.

name: Sideways Roll
description: Inhale and pivot on the lead foot, turning the body and the staff together to face a flanking attacker.

name: Tipcaplid
description: Trace a slow figure eight with the shaft before the body, qi passing along it to turn low and high cuts alike.

name: Blockblow
description: Let a spin build speed, then snap the wrists to flick the tip against the opponent's temple or hand.

name: Lowered Tipcap
description: Catch the spinning staff flat in both hands and breathe out, bringing qi and guard back to rest together.

name: Holding Bostip
description: Stand square with the staff slanted across the body, qi settling in the legs as a drillmaster's count begins.

name: Short Spinbreak
description: Drive the staff forward on the count, qi surging to the tip at the final beat and fading at once.

name: Kept Leftgrip
description: Meet a strike with the shaft on the first beat, then send the same staff back out on the second.

name: Swaying Spinbreak
description: Step forward in a steady march while the shaft rides level, each footfall landing on the drilled beat.

name: Firm Rightgrip
description: Carry qi through a low sweep on the strong beat so the staff cracks against the opponent's shins.

name: Whitewood Stay
description: Freeze with the staff upright after the last count, holding qi level in the arms until the drillmaster releases.

name: Roundstaff Stay
description: Stand half-turned with the staff between body and opponent, qi resting low in the legs for quick steps.

name: Light Spinbreak
description: Let qi lighten the feet and glide forward without lifting them, the shaft held steady at the hips.

name: Level Pivot
description: Step off the opponent's centre line to one side and thrust the staff from that flank.

name: Quiet Tipcap
description: Pivot on the lead foot and swap ends of the staff as the body turns, so the strike comes from behind.

name: Snug Taperend
description: Drop the near end to the ground in front of the lead foot and turn a low strike off its line.

name: Stepping Sweepstep
description: Slip the lead foot outside the opponent's reach as the staff points back, drawing the attack onto empty ground.

name: Short Roll
description: Push hard off the rear foot with qi in the leg and jab as the hips arrive, stretching the reach.

name: Settled Whitewood
description: Let the first thin flow of qi settle in the shoulders so the staff lies steady and the guard stays high.

name: Blockdash
description: Touch qi into the near end as it taps the opponent's forearm, adding a small sting to the blow.

name: Resting Taperend
description: Cross the staff before the face while qi hardens the forearms, taking a heavy blow without shock.

name: Staffcentre Amble
description: Send qi down into the legs and cover two paces in one, the staff held level to guard the gain.

name: Angled Balancenode
description: Flick the staff outward with a pulse of qi along its length, snapping an incoming point wide.

name: Bostip Husk
description: Plant the staff and breathe out slowly, drawing the scattered qi in the arms back into one steady flow.
